en-US.name: Vision Protect
en-US.summary: Schedules one to five 20-minute focus periods with regular eye breaks.
en-US.description: Vision Protect is a general-audience productivity tool for adults who spend extended time using a computer or other screen. It schedules one to five complete 20-minute focus periods, with a 30-second distance-viewing break between periods. Five periods is the default and lasts 102 minutes. Reminders permission is required. Starting a new session replaces any earlier Vision Protect session.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Vision Protect to start
Alexa, ask Vision Protect to cancel my session

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable Reminders permission for the skill. Say, 'Alexa, open Vision Protect.' Alexa asks whether to start five 20-minute focus periods. Answer 'yes.' Confirm that nine relative reminders are created: breaks at 20:00, 40:30, 61:00, and 81:30; resume notices 30 seconds after each break; and completion at 102:00. Open the skill again, answer 'no,' and choose a number from one to five. Confirm the reminder count matches the selection. Start it again and confirm earlier reminders are replaced rather than duplicated. Say, 'Alexa, ask Vision Protect to cancel my session,' and confirm all Vision Protect reminders are removed.
